items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Doris Day was on the band, the first band I was on with Les.

ctx.x: Shall we use it as a loose term?

It’s a loose term. All I did was for instance, Doris Day was on the band, the first band I was on with Les. And they needed somebody to do a little something like, you know “The Night is Young” [scats]. I would say, “It’s” and she did all the rest. Delightful. Delicious. It’s d’lovely. And I’d just stand there and say, “It’s.” So that was the extent of my — except that when we did some things like “Alexander the Swoose” and I remember I still don’t remember, I don’t remember what I said on “Alexander the Swoose”…
That’s a good story. Did the bands — needed to have some kind of gimmick at that time, to be competitive with one another?
